name: manifest-journal-index-mismatch
description: journal.seg whose header declares segment_index 0 instead of the reserved 0xFFFFFFFF.
asserts: The journal's segment_index is the reserved 0xFFFFFFFF. A journal that claims a capture index is a capture segment in disguise. The manifest signature, content root and member digests are all valid: a valid signature binds the manifest to the device, not the manifest to its segments.
